text:
maya (product): quick sync 1: customers keep asking for concrete acceptance criteria for enterprise compliance (audit logs, BYOK/KMS, SOC2/ISO readiness, long-term retention). need a short, executable plan.
kevin (eng): agree. key tech limits: indexing cost for long retention, BYOK handshake latency, and export sizing for >1y. recommend phased deliverables.
jenna (security): must include: KMS attestation path, key rotation policy, and proof-of-deletion semantics. SOC2 teams expect deterministic audit export schema.
omar (sales): priority: FinCo and AcmeBank want BYOK + 7-year retention. they need clear timeline and acceptance tests for contract.
erin (custeng): AcmeBank pilot asks: 1) BYOK with HSM attestation (or partner attestation), 2) searchable audit exports for 90d, 3) tenant-level retention toggle. They accept phased delivery.
maya (product): propose Phase A (MVP): cloud-KMS BYOK handshake + 90d hot audit export + tenant retention presets. Phase B: long-term cold archive (1y/7y), immutable exports, legal-hold API. keep A narrow.
kevin (eng): Phase A OK if BYOK scoped to cloud KMS (no in-house HSM attestation). Phase B needs archival store + index reconstruction plan. note: continuous batching may affect export latency for big ranges.
jenna (security): FinCo requires HSM attestation before production. propose offering attestation-as-a-service with an HSM partner for enterprise tier. will draft threat-model addendum.
sara (legal): contract note: avoid promising absolute deletion. define SLOs for export completion, retention TTL, and escrow/escrow access. acceptance = passing staged tests + sample exports.
omar (sales): we can charge a pilot fee and promise an acceptance window. customers want written acceptance cases.
maya (product): draft acceptance tests now: 1) BYOK handshake: ingest external key, record handshake logs, validate key-id in audit entries. 2) Audit export: generate NDJSON schema v1 with chain-of-custody headers. 3) Retention toggle: set tenant retention=7y; run TTL job; verify tombstone + export snapshot.
erin (custeng): add: searchable recent sample <15m for 90d window. customers need rapid forensics on recent requests.
kevin (eng): 15m sample feasible for 90d if we keep hot index. 7y cold archives will be paginated and slower; will produce cost estimate.
jenna (security): regression tests must assert audit entries include request-id, model-version, route, tenant-id, and kms-key-id.
audit-bot: ticket COMPLIANCE-7622 created: "BYOK + audit export acceptance tests" assigned to eng/security/product.
sara (legal): I'll draft contract language for acceptance, rollback windows, and SLO credits.
maya (product): next steps: kevin + jenna to produce tech-spec + test harness by EOW, sara to draft contract clause, omar to coordinate pilot prioritization, erin to schedule AcmeBank kickoff. keep Phase A minimal. :eyes:
